props.line: 36.5 at most major books; consensus 35.5, opened 33.5
props.why: Seattle took Diggs away in the Super Bowl and the other Patriots receivers saw 7+ targets each. That bracket goes to A.J. Brown now. Doubs cleared this number in 10 of 17 games last year.
props.result: 0 catches on 3 targets. Maye threw three picks in a 13-10 loss; Hollins led the Patriots with 5 targets and 51 yards.

props.line: 38.5 (-114 over) on the Sept 7 board; confirm on your book
props.why: 102 catches for 924 yards last year, 54 a game. With Kittle on a snap watch and two new receivers, Purdy's first read in Melbourne is the one it has been for three years.
props.result: 5 catches for 20 yards on 8 targets in a 27-7 49ers win. Purdy went 25 of 34 for 205 and three scores, and the targets went wide: Evans and Deebo 7 each.

props.line: 56.5 (-113) at DraftKings, Sept 14 morning; confirm on your book
props.why: He averaged 59 a game in Miami with a worse quarterback mix and a run-first script. Denver under Nix is one of the most pass-happy offenses in the league (612 attempts last year), and Kansas City's secondary lost McDuffie, Watson and Cook this offseason. The model has him at 65 a game on a 25% target share; I have him 28th on the board.
props.result: 1 catch for 2 yards on 3 targets in a 31-10 loss. Denver ran 15 times and threw 28; Nix went 131 yards, and the ball went to Bryant (6 targets), Engram and Sutton (5 each). No injury reported.

props.line: 18.5 at DraftKings, Sept 17 morning (opened 18.5); confirm the price on your book
props.why: 29 of Detroit's 33 carries in Week 1 with Montgomery gone to Houston. A normal Lions game is 24 to 28 rushes, and 80% of that clears the number. After three yardage misses, this week's plays are volume props on roles the board and the box score agree on.

survivor.why: The contrarian pick on purpose. The Chargers and Jaguars are half of every pool this week; Philadelphia is a 5.5-point home favorite in a division game, about 68% to win, and roughly 3% of entries. Daniels is healthy and Kingsbury is gone, and I trust the Eagles' floor over that offense's first game in a new scheme.
survivor.result: Eagles 24, Commanders 22. Hurts went 14 of 25 for 203 yards and three touchdowns, and Washington's tying two-point try was stuffed with 1:01 left. Alive.

dfs.note: The five I built around, posted Sunday morning with projected ownership: Swift 7%, Brown 7%, Hampton 4%, Wilson 5%, McBride 4%. Gibbs (57%) in the lineup too.
dfs.result: Swift 18 for 124 and three scores plus a catch, 35.4 DK points at 7% owned. McBride 9 catches for 95 and a touchdown on 13 targets, 24.5. Brown 56 yards and a score with 5 catches, 18.8. Wilson 6 for 79, 13.9. Hampton was the miss: 12 carries for 43, a touchdown and a lost fumble, 9.3, in a 26-14 upset. Gibbs 29 for 156 and two. Cashed.
